name: Projector control
description: Control network projectors over PJLink (class 1): on and off, input, picture and sound mute, and their state, lamp hours and warnings checked in the background. Private addresses only; passwords are never shown again. Adds projector power to the schedule and the old OSC /beameron and /beameroff. Not yet tried on a real projector. Serial (RS-232) control is not built.
